judge.decoding: default; temperature not accepted on claude-opus-5

gate_1_true_minus_placebo.refusal_convention: counted as NO; denominators held at the number of items drawn

if_refusals_excluded.note: reported so the convention is visible; it moves the gap by at most one item over the denominator

gap_ceiling.why: the gap is the true-arm rate minus the placebo rate and the placebo rate cannot fall below zero, so the true-arm rate is the largest gap this design can produce

verdict: both gates pass, so the agreement figures may be read; this is a third instrument and not human validation
